description: Maryland Unemployment Insurance uses BEACON for claims and weekly certifications. Job-search records are entered separately in the Maryland Workforce Exchange.
introduction: Maryland Unemployment Insurance uses BEACON for claims and weekly certifications. Job-search records are entered separately in the Maryland Workforce Exchange.

who: Eligibility depends on sufficient covered wages, the circumstances of job separation and continuing weekly requirements.
You generally must be able and available for work and conduct required job-search activity unless the state recognizes an exemption.
sections.get: The state determines temporary unemployment payments from the claim. A wage calculation does not guarantee payment for a week with an unresolved eligibility issue.
sections.docs: Prepare personal identity information and employment history for the last 18 months. Keep separation records and follow any identity verification request. Save job-search confirmations as activities occur.
sections.apply:
1. Start from Maryland Labor’s Apply Now link to the claimant BEACON portal, or call a claims agent at 667-207-6520.
  2. Register in Maryland Workforce Exchange and complete required profile and résumé steps.
  3. Unless exempt, record three weekly search activities, including one direct employer contact, in MWE before submitting the weekly BEACON certification.
sections.after: Continue the weekly steps while a decision or payment is pending, as instructed. MWE and BEACON have different credentials. Read determinations and use the stated appeal deadline if you disagree.
sections.sources:
• Maryland unemployment claimant entry
  • Maryland weekly search and certification order
  • USA Assistance background and screenshots

faqs: Is MWE the same login as BEACON?
No. Maryland says the two systems use different usernames and passwords.
Document job-search activities in MWE before completing the BEACON weekly certification.
How much job searching is required?
Unless exempt, at least three weekly activities, including one direct job contact.
Should I stop certifying while waiting for payment?
The state directs claimants to continue search documentation and certifications while waiting.

provenance.review_scope: Program purpose, eligibility pathway and application methods; no unverified dollar limits published.
